mms_quotations.title: Antifouling Service – Saxdor 400 (39.7 ft Motor Yacht)
mms_quotations.notes: Payment terms: 0 days (full payment due upon invoice). Deposit: 50% required before work commences. Quotation valid for 7 days. VAT 7% applicable on all items. Scope includes haul-out (round trip), bottom pressure wash, antifouling labour (standard), antifouling paint materials (2 coats), and haul-back. Boat has been in water approx. 1 year – standard 2-coat antifouling system recommended. If excessive fouling or osmotic blistering is found upon haul-out, additional preparation charges may apply and will be quoted separately. Bottom area estimated using standard formula for motor yacht LOA 39.7 ft: approx. 42 sqm (LOA × beam factor; beam assumed ~12 ft for Saxdor 400).

mms_quotations.title: Saxdor 400 – Bottom Wash, Antifouling & Zinc Anode Works
mms_quotations.notes: Quotation valid for 7 days from date of issue. Payment terms: 0 days (payment due on completion). Deposit: 50% required prior to commencement of works. Scope covers bottom pressure wash (pre-antifouling), antifouling labour, epoxy primer labour, antifouling paint and primer materials (estimated), and zinc anode replacement. All works to be carried out in the workshop yard (W). VAT 7% applicable. LOA 39.7 ft. Bottom area: 12.10m x 3.70m x 0.55 = 24.6 sqm (manufacturer beam confirmed). Zinc anode qty confirmed by yard supervisor: 22 units (shaft, prop, trim tab, hull, engine positions). Zinc anode labour revised to 8 hrs. Pilot test quotation — do not mark as sent.
